After school Clubs and Wrap Around Care
‘WRAP AROUND CHILDCARE’ AT HAVERSHAM VILLAGE SCHOOL
Breakfast Club opens each morning, with parents being able to book care for their children from 7.30am. Quality care and a healthy breakfast are available. Breakfast club is run in the school hall with entrance through the doors to the school hall.
7.30 am – 8.40 / 8.45 am DAILY
7.30 am – £5.00 – Breakfast included
7.45 am – £4.00 – Breakfast included
8.00 am – £3.00 – Breakfast included
8.25 am – £2.00 – Breakfast Not included
After School Club is able to take care of children between 3.15 – 6.00 pm. The children have light refreshments, and are able to relax at the end of the day with a variety of activities. The club is currently based in the KS2 and collection is made from the KS2 top door.
From 3.15 – 4.15 pm – £ 5
From 3.15 – 5.15 pm – £ 8
From 3.15 – 5.30 pm – £ 9
From 4.15 – 5.15 pm – £ 4
From 4.15 – 5.30 pm – £ 5
From 3.15 – 6.00 pm – £ 11
EXTRA-CURRICULAR AFTER SCHOOL CLUBS
Alongside our wrap around care children also have the opportunity to attend a variety of extra-curricular after school clubs such as football, badminton, drawing and sketching and performance choir.
These run from 3.15 – 4.15 pm and cost £4 per session. These are available on a first come first served basis and are bookable through Parentmail.

Pupil Premium
Our mission statement is: “Bringing out the best in everyone”. The targeted and strategic use of Pupil Premium will support us in achieving our mission.
Pupil Premium (Disadvantaged Grant) – What is it?
The Disadvantaged Grant is a grant allocated to schools to support disadvantaged children on the FSM register or who have been on the register in the last six years. These children are eligible for free school meals (FSM) (separate to the Infant School Meals Grant), so for Year 3 to Year 6 children. Each of these pupils attracts a specific amount of funding. Schools have the freedom to spend the grant, which is additional to the main school budget, in a way they think will best support the raising of attainment for the most vulnerable pupils.
Why is it important?
At Haversham Village School the Pupil Premium is focused on raising attainment. Attainment and achievement are closely tracked throughout the school. The performance of individual pupils and groups are very closely monitored to ensure that no one person or group is underachieving.
The School Development Plan clearly identifies the annual priorities which are the focus to take the school forward. It highlights priorities and shows how they are to be achieved. Raising standards is a constant focus and it is within this planning structure that pupil premium expenditure is targeted. Pupils who meet the criteria are supported through additional resources to achieve maximum impact on their attainment and achievement.
Governors monitor the use and effectiveness of the Pupil Premium Grant at their Curriculum and Staffing Meetings and the Full Governing Body Meetings which take place once a term.

Admissions
As Haversham Village School is a Community School the Local Authority decides our admissions. Please contact MKCC School Admissions Department to find out the admission arrangements and criteria for our school.
Admissions are allocated by the Local Authority according to the criteria set for our school. Current policies and guidelines can be found at https://www.milton-keynes.gov.uk/schools-and-lifelong-learning/school-admissions/admission-arrangements
The Education Access Team can be contacted on – 01908 253 338
If you are interested in joining our school community we would love to show you around our wonderful school. Please contact the school office on 01908 312 673 or office@haversham.milton-keynes.sch.uk to arrange an appointment.
© 2018 HAVERSHAM VILLAGE SCHOOL // DESIGN BY BLUE APPLE EDUCATION

Ethos & Values
Aims of the School
As a school we aim to “bring out the best in every one” by providing a safe environment where we promote pupils’ welfare, mental health and education. Within this environment, we work hard to build pupils’ resilience by promoting fundamental British values through our attitudes to learning.
Our school values are threaded throughout everything we do at school. They are promoted within the classrooms and the staff refer to them whilst praising positive learning behaviours.
As a school we value our relationships with parents and families and understand that our aims are best achieved through an active partnership with parents, carers, children and governors.

Headteacher’s Welcome
I would like to welcome you to our school website on behalf of the children, staff and Governors.
Headteacher’s Welcome
WELCOME TO HAVERSHAM VILLAGE SCHOOL
‘Bringing out the best in everyone’
On behalf of the children, staff and governors, I am delighted to welcome you to our school. I feel extremely privileged to be leading a fantastic team of staff who are committed, aspirational and caring.
As a school our aim is simple, to offer all children a memorable education that brings out the best in everyone. It is our shared belief that children should receive a broad and balanced education that is rich in terms of knowledge, skills and experiences, developing the ability to question and communicate effectively as well as nurturing them to become self-confident lifelong learners.
We highly value the creative side of the curriculum and the benefits it brings to children’s wellbeing and sense of achievement. At Haversham, the creative curriculum does not end in the classroom but extends beyond the school day into our extended school provision. This allows for opportunities to develop and learn beyond the classroom. Our wonderful school boasts our own home economics room, a dedicated workshop, a multi-use gaming area (MUGA), a tennis court, an adventure play area, a large playground and plenty of green areas in and around the school.
As Headteacher, I aim to strengthen links with the community – the children, families and friends of the school. We recognise that, as parents, you are an essential partner in the educational process and we place great value on the support we receive from you. You know your children better than anyone and we work together to bring out the best in your children. We highly advocate parental involvement and ask you to trust in us to do the best for your child.
We hope that you find our website informative. It is designed to give you a small snapshot of the vibrant life of our school, the brilliant work of our pupils and the inspirational dedication of our staff but the best way to get a true impression of our school is to visit during the school day. We warmly welcome prospective parents, if you would like a tour of our school please contact the school office.
